name: pi-figma-return-guard
description: Pi extension: blocks Figma MCP use_figma scripts that return images as base64, which exceed the 48,000-byte return limit and discard the run's canvas edits.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/figma-return-guard.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/prompt-hint.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/error-guidance.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/journal.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings tests/lessons.test.mjs
